catalog.note: Films chosen because country-level box-office splits are public, which makes the later backtest possible. Control titles are globally distributed tentpoles expected to rank similarly everywhere; the rest are titles with known regional skew. Fixed before any API call was made.

prompts.note: 30 prompts: 3 cities x 10 taste profiles. Cities are deliberately not the top-5 most-written-about metros, because an LLM's hallucination rate in Paris tells you nothing about its rate where the training data thins out.
tastes: Wong Kar-wai films and Nils Frahm
Elena Ferrante novels and slow food

model_config.note: Pinned and hashed. A re-run against a newer default model is a different experiment, not a replication.

location_signal_test.pass_if: >=2 non-US market pairs with Kendall tau-b < 0.70, each with overlap n >= 12, catalog-composition hi95 < 0.85, and control-set rank variance below the rest of the catalog
location_signal_test.uncertainty_method: jackknife SE of the observed tau, tested against the 0.70 threshold. The null SE (0.1427 at n=25) is reported as a different-from-random sanity line only: tau's variance shrinks toward 0 as tau approaches 1, so judging an observed tau near the top against a null-hypothesis spread mixes two distributions and overstates uncertainty.
location_signal_test.overlap_floor: Pairs sharing fewer than 12 titles are marked INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP and cannot qualify. Surviving titles skew to the globally popular ones, which are least likely to reorder, so a thin overlap biases tau upward.

groundwork_gap_test.metric: gap = (best shipped LLM configuration) - (Qloo), both verified by the same OpenStreetMap instrument
groundwork_gap_test.alive_if: 95% Newcombe lower bound on the gap above 0 AND point estimate >= 10 points
groundwork_gap_test.arms: ungrounded LLM, grounded LLM with search, Qloo control
groundwork_gap_test.supersedes: An earlier registration set >=25% / <=10% against the LLM's OWN failure rate. Adding the Qloo control changed what is being measured -- a rate became a difference -- so the threshold had to be re-derived rather than carried over. This is a LOOSENING of the bar and is recorded as such. No live call had been made when it was changed.
groundwork_gap_test.decides: whether the Groundwork branch has a premise at all

normalisation_test.per_query_if: the same entity's affinity changes between two different candidate sets
normalisation_test.consequence: all cross-call ratio maths is abandoned in favour of within-query ranks

planned_backtest.design: predict relative country-level performance for the catalog from Qloo ranks alone, compare against public country box office splits
honesty_constraints: titles and metric fixed here, before outcomes are looked up
Qloo's graph is built partly from real consumption signal, so this is less circular than scoring Qloo with Qloo, NOT independent of it
report N and the confidence interval, never a bare correlation

warning: Original pre-registration retained in prereg.json. Any threshold changed after data was seen must be disclosed when the numbers are quoted.
